shouldFix.title: The status-token member name asserts the opposite of its value
shouldFix.detail: The live DR-105 token is OPEN, and the member value correctly says that leftover-design/OPEN is the token rather than a finding. The member name `leftoverDesignOpenIsAFinding`, however, structurally asserts that it is a finding. This is the DR-104 template name carried into an OPEN row and leaves contradictory machine-readable semantics even though the prose is correct.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Rename the member to a neutral and accurate name such as `leftoverDesignOpenStanding` or `rowTokenStanding`, preserving the current value and the live OPEN token. Do not edit file 08.

shouldFix.title: The leftover partition omits authoring the fourteen permission fixture implementations
shouldFix.detail: D-056 Decision clause 5 distinguishes authoring fixtures from authoring harness specifications and classifies both as design work; only execution is qualification. Both permission-truth-tables.v2 and v9 state that FX-1, FX-2A, FX-2B, and FX-3..FX-13 are `SPECIFICATIONS OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT, not implementations`, that no fixture exists, and that no harness runs. Each generation has fourteen class specifications and zero fixture path or SHA-256 members. The join records OBL-G09-HARNESS-SPEC as design leftover and OBL-G09-EXECUTION as qualification, but it has no obligation for authoring and pinning the fixture bytes. Consequently its six-member leftover summary and proposed later-work list are incomplete even though it does not close the row today.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Add a distinct leftover-design obligation for authoring and independently pinning the fourteen FX fixture implementations, or explicitly broaden the G09 authoring obligation to cover both the harness specification and fixture corpus. Add it to the summary, doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, and proposedLaterWork while keeping execution separate, unperformed, and at G09 qualification.

summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 2 SHOULD-FIX. The candidate correctly preserves DR-105 as OPEN, retains FC-C1 and BLK-1..4 as design leftovers, excludes discharged BLK-5/6/7, separates G09 execution as qualification, assigns no gate, leaves required-now at 26, and applies or executes nothing. Two repairable completeness/honesty defects remain. First, the JSON key `leftoverDesignOpenIsAFinding` contradicts its own correct value and the live OPEN token. Second, the candidate omits fixture implementation authoring: both pinned permission-table generations say their fourteen FX classes are intent specifications only and that no fixture exists, while D-056 treats fixture authoring and harness-specification authoring as separate design work. Tracking only the G09 harness specification and eventual execution does not account for those missing exact-byte fixtures. No subject, source, file-08, COORD, FC-C1, candidate-application, gate, fixture, or implementation mutation was performed by this review.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Escalating the missing fixture-authoring obligation to a blocker
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: The omission makes the inventory incomplete, but this candidate still refuses closure, leaves gates 2 and 3 false, and authorizes no application or implementation. A mandatory successor repair is sufficient.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Charging candidate-local identity dependencies from permission-truth-tables.v9 as additional live DR-105 leftovers
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: D-128 records v9 as CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and binds NOTHING, and this join expressly leaves its ID-DEP rides on that candidate. This review does not promote candidate-local dependencies into live obligations; the fixture-authoring defect is different because D-056 independently classifies known absent fixture implementations as design work for eligibility.
